sources.evidence: Documents /api/websocket authentication and configuration registry command types, including entity display and exposure operations.
Documents add-on, backup, job, and update endpoints; authorization requires a Supervisor token.
States that Supervisor access is separate from the Home Assistant proxy and requires an app role/token.
Documents bearer-token REST endpoints for states, services, history, logbook, templates, and configuration validation.

Core registers calendar/event create, update, delete, subscribe_events, recorder/statistics_during_period, config_entries, Lovelace, system_health, and radio command contracts used by the absorb surface.
Custom component supplies ha_mcp_tools/dashboards and helpers_list plus mounted-config filesystem and edit_yaml_config capability contracts; file/YAML access is opt-in and constrained.

local_config.go enforces a bounded configuration/packages/themes/www/custom_templates/dashboards allowlist, rejects traversal and symlink escape, masks secrets.yaml, and uses atomic rename writes; unit tests cover each boundary.
